title: Parallax Fantasy Map
description: A detailed fantasy map illustration on aged parchment depicts a winding river flowing from distant blue mountains through red rock canyons, farmlands, and a forested region. Visible landmarks include a tall striped lighthouse tower on the left, a circular stone arena, two elevated tree platforms connected by bridges, and small figures working in golden crop fields.
prompt: Wide horizontal fantasy map on old parchment paper with a compass rose in the corner, showing a continuous landscape from purple foreground mountains to distant blue peaks. A wide river winds through red rock canyons, golden agricultural fields with tiny workers, a tall striped lighthouse tower, a circular stone arena, two large treehouse platforms connected by rope bridges, and dense blue-green forests. Stylized parallax layers with clear depth, warm earthy tones, detailed yet illustrative fantasy cartography style.
